title: High-altitude nuclear tests burned holes in the Van Allen belt
summary: Jesse Michels tells of High-altitude nuclear tests burned holes in the Van Allen belt, about 1950s-1960s at Upper atmosphere / Van Allen belt, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: like the high altitude nuclear test they would just burn holes in the Van Allen belt

plain: Jesse Michels, a podcast host who talks with guests about UFOs and hidden science, says that the nuclear bombs set off high in the sky in the 1950s and 60s would "burn holes" in the Van Allen belt. That belt is a zone of charged particles held around the Earth by its magnetic field, far above the planet. In his telling, these tests did real damage to a natural shield around our world.
